title: Hypnotic Holidays 3!
description:
We are BACK for another holiday season of giving. You giving to a fantastic cause, and me giving you amazing new FREE content!

Why don’t you skip the rest and just donate now , OK?

The more you give, the more you unlock for the hypnokink community. Even the smallest donation gets you a slot in a raffle for a THIRTY MINUTE custom file! And everyone who donates gets a file that no-one else hears. Just make sure you add your email when you donate or you’ll miss out.

The community reward milestones are really exciting too. I’ve got the naughtiest novella idea, a really fun background file in mind, and I cannot wait to make a really hot choose your own adventure series – multiple routes, all hypnotic and hot!

The cause is fantastic too. Women’s Aid are a resource for women suffering domestic violence across the UK and Ireland . As you can imagine, I’m all about women being empowered, and Women’s Aid help them to find the strength and resources they need to escape horrible situations.

So please, please, please donate this holiday season!
author: Mistress Calia
